evals.name: simple-remote-command
evals.prompt: Run 'ls -la' on the remote server to see what files are in the workspace
evals.expected_output: The skill should ask which server to use, then execute the ls command via SSH and display the file listing output

evals.name: run-tests-with-conda
evals.prompt: Connect to server A and run the unit tests using the test-env conda environment
evals.expected_output: The skill should: 1) Present server options, 2) User selects Server A, 3) Ask for conda environment (user specifies 'test-env'), 4) Ask for command (user specifies test command), 5) Execute via SSH with conda activation

evals.name: quick-status-check
evals.prompt: Check what processes are running on server B
evals.expected_output: The skill should connect to Server B and execute a process checking command (like 'ps aux' or 'top')

evals.name: multi-command-build
evals.prompt: On server A, clean and rebuild the project using the build-env environment
evals.expected_output: The skill should activate build-env and execute build commands (make clean, make, etc.)

evals.name: no-conda-environment
evals.prompt: Run a simple command on server A without activating any conda environment
evals.expected_output: The skill should skip conda activation and just run the command directly after sourcing conda_source.sh
